verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Windows is a primary target for current toolchains: C# with .NET 8+, C++ (Win32 and C++/WinRT), Rust via windows-rs, plus WinUI 3 quickstarts and developer tools. AI/ML work is covered by the Windows AI Foundry toolkit, Windows AI APIs and local AI tools. Community reports note compiling C code on Windows for CI and the Ubuntu userland (WSL) as a developer draw. missing for 10: explicit evidence of support for the latest IDEs (no IDE is named), detail on mainstream third-party AI/ML frameworks beyond Microsoft's own toolkits, and independent hands-on corroboration of current toolchain and AI tooling.
